texts.preamble: Nand Bhai And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2019 Author: Siddharth Bench: Siddharth
texts.arguments: It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicants that the applicants are absolutely innocent and have been falsely implicated in the present case with some ulterior motive. Despite existence of Special Act i.e.,Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.False implication has been alleged. Applicant has been falsely implicated for the offence under sections 272, 273 I.P.C. The applicants are languishing in jail since 15.6.2019, who are not previous convicts. Per contra learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant by contending that the innocence of the applicants cannot be adjudged at pre trial stage, therefore, they do not deserves any indulgence.
